clarifications.assignment_projection: Always exactly id, course_id, name, html_url, due_at, points_possible; absent source key is null. Current and history raw dictionaries retain key absence.
clarifications.ids: Positive integer excluding bool or nonempty ASCII digit string; remove leading zeroes without imposing a magnitude bound; all-zero is invalid.
clarifications.queries: Two GET requests only. The existing CanvasClient adds per_page=50; otherwise assignment has no includes, self submission has exactly the two advertised includes.

groups: Rich raw records and duplicate preservation; isolated deep output mutation cannot alter native fixture dictionaries.
Nine combinations of absent, null and empty history/comments; exact six-key assignment unknowns and no current-attempt synthesis.

Both identifier positions reject booleans, nonintegral/type-invalid values, Unicode digits, whitespace and path/query punctuation before any client request; admitted padded/large IDs normalize exactly.
Wrong endpoint envelopes and malformed late history/comment rows refuse the entire report, including a valid leading record; raw input remains unchanged.
Actual CLI rich report via loopback HTTP with padded IDs, exact inherited query shape, metadata-only links, and no write/download request.
Two actual CLI reads after the server changes the same assignment payload return current distinct history, without inventing or retaining stale records.
Actual CLI Unicode/zero/negative identifiers, malformed row, HTTP 403 and malformed JSON produce nonzero JSON errors and no successful partial stdout.
Real MCP stdio catalog exposes the string/string caller; repeated calls in one process observe changed payloads with exact two-GET shapes.
Real MCP bad typed/string IDs and malformed records remain isError, make no forbidden requests, and a later valid call in the same process succeeds.
baseline_control: Record absent API method, actual unsupported CLI exit, absent real MCP catalog entry, and zero fixture HTTP calls before candidate execution.
isolation: Explicit synthetic token, loopback-only base URL and owned unused profile in every process. No browser/session calls or account operations. Native real CanvasClient fixtures for API cases, native real HTTP transport for CLI/MCP cases.
qualification_boundary: Native metadata-reader API/CLI/MCP receiving with authored fixtures; no live Canvas account, completeness inference, GUI, downloads, grade/submission writes, or deployment.
status: Contract semantics frozen before candidate source access; transport bindings derived solely from exact baseline.
